kindHelp.PROCESS_HOUSE: Process codes, names, category, parent, owner and department. Builds or updates the process tree.
kindHelp.DEPARTMENTS: Department codes, names and parent department (hierarchy).
kindHelp.USERS: Names, e-mail, department, roles and job roles. No passwords: new users get an invitation e-mail or sign in with SSO.
kindHelp.BPMN: One or more .bpmn / .xml files or a ZIP (Signavio, Camunda, Bizagi, ARIS and other BPMN 2.0 exports).
kindHelp.VISIO: Visio drawings with BPMN or basic flowchart shapes and swimlanes become BPMN drafts. Save old .vsd files as .vsdx first.
kindHelp.ARIS: ARIS Markup Language exports: EPCs, value-added chain diagrams and objects (roles, systems).
kindHelp.DMN: DMN 1.3 files (.dmn / .xml) or a ZIP of them.
kindHelp.WORD: Word (.docx) SOPs, policies and guides become wiki pages with headings, lists, tables, images and links.
kindHelp.PDF: Text is extracted into a page and the original PDF is attached. Scanned PDFs are flagged for manual work.
kindHelp.CONFLUENCE: The ZIP of a Confluence space HTML export: pages with hierarchy, attachments and rewritten internal links.
kindHelp.MARKDOWN: Markdown files or a ZIP of a folder: pages follow the folder structure, images become attachments.
kindHelp.PACKAGE: A full export package of another ProcessHub installation (moving servers or restoring into an empty installation).
kindHelp.GRC_RISKS: The risk register template of Risk & Compliance.
kindHelp.GRC_CONTROLS: The control register template of Risk & Compliance.
kindHelp.EA_DATA_OBJECTS: Data objects and their system of record.

attachTo.MATCH_OR_CREATE: Attach to the matching process (code / file name) or create a new one

layout.MISSING: Auto-layout only when the layout is missing

optionHelp.defaultOwnerId: Owner of imported items when the file does not name one.
optionHelp.updateExisting: Items that match by code, e-mail, external id or file name are updated (drafts only) instead of duplicated.
optionHelp.sendInvitations: New users receive a link to set their password (not with single sign-on).
optionHelp.parentProcessId: New processes are created below this process.
optionHelp.linkProcesses: Process codes and names in the file name, title or text become link suggestions.

center.title: Import Center
center.subtitle: Move existing processes, diagrams, documents and lists into ProcessHub: preview, check, apply — and undo while still in Draft.

batch.failed: The import could not be read.
batch.discardConfirm: Discard this batch and its files?
batch.applyConfirmText: {{create}} items will be created and {{update}} updated, all as Draft.

undo.title: Undo {{number}}
undo.blocked: Undo is not possible while these items are in use:
undo.text: {{count}} items created by this batch will be removed (soft delete, audited). Updates of existing items are kept.

reason.HAS_CHILDREN: has items added outside the batch

summary.blocking: {{count}} items have errors: fix the file or exclude them before applying.

issue.COLUMN_MISSING: The column "{{column}}" was not found: map it in the column mapping.
issue.CODE_TOO_LONG: The code is longer than 50 characters.
issue.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: {{code}} appears more than once in the file.
issue.NAME_REQUIRED: A name in English or Arabic is required.
issue.CATEGORY_REQUIRED: The category is missing (and there is no parent to inherit it from).
issue.UNKNOWN_OWNER: No user with the e-mail {{email}}. Choose a default owner or fix the file.
issue.UNKNOWN_OWNER_DEFAULT: No user with the e-mail {{email}}: the default owner is used.
issue.PARENT_CYCLE: The parent chain forms a loop.
issue.UNKNOWN_PARENT: The parent {{code}} exists neither in the file nor in ProcessHub.
issue.LEVEL_ADJUSTED: Level {{given}} in the file; the tree gives level {{level}}.
issue.PARENT_CHANGE_IGNORED: Moving an existing process to {{code}} is not done by an import: move it in the process tree.
issue.CATEGORY_CHANGE_IGNORED: The category of an existing process is not changed.
issue.NOT_DRAFT_SKIPPED: The process is {{status}}: only drafts are updated by an import.
issue.UNKNOWN_MANAGER_IGNORED: No user with the e-mail {{email}}: the head is not set.
issue.USERS_SIGN_IN_WITH_SSO: Single sign-on is on: new users sign in with their organisation account (no invitation e-mail).
issue.NO_EMAIL_FOR_INVITATIONS: E-mail is not configured: invitations cannot be sent. Configure e-mail first or set passwords by hand.
issue.INVALID_EMAIL: "{{email}}" is not a valid e-mail address.
issue.ROLE_NOT_IMPORTABLE: Super Admins are not created by an import (assign "{{value}}" by hand).
issue.MFA_REQUIRED_AT_SIGN_IN: {{roles}} requires two-step verification: the user enrols at the first sign-in.
issue.BREAK_GLASS_UNCHANGED: The break-glass account is never changed by an import.
issue.OWN_ACCOUNT_UNCHANGED: Your own account is not changed by your import.
issue.SUPER_ADMIN_UNCHANGED: Super Admin accounts are not changed by an import.
issue.LAYOUT_FIRST_POOL: {{count}} pools: the automatic layout keeps the first one.
issue.LAYOUT_DROPPED: {{count}} elements (data objects, annotations, message flows …) are not kept by the automatic layout.
issue.LAYOUT_GENERATED: The file has no diagram layout: it was laid out automatically.
issue.AMBIGUOUS_NAME: {{count}} processes have this name: a new process is created.
issue.MODEL_REPLACED: The current diagram of {{code}} is replaced (a new version is saved).
issue.VISIO_LOOSE_CONNECTORS: {{count}} connectors are not attached at both ends and were left out.
issue.VISIO_OUTSIDE_LANES: {{count}} shapes are outside every swimlane (placed in the first lane).
issue.VISIO_UNMAPPED: {{count}} × "{{shape}}" not mapped to BPMN (see the shape mapping).
issue.VISIO_NO_FLOWS: No connectors were found between the shapes.
issue.NO_DIAGRAMS_FOUND: No diagrams were found in the files.
issue.NOT_AML: {{file}} is not an ARIS Markup Language (AML) export.
issue.ARIS_MODELS_SKIPPED: {{count}} models of other types are not imported ({{types}}).
issue.ARIS_UNSUPPORTED_OBJECTS: {{count}} shapes of other object types are left out.
issue.LIBRARY_OBJECT_EXISTS: Already in the library: the existing object is used.
issue.INVALID_DIAGRAM: The diagram content is not valid.
issue.NOT_DMN: {{file}} is not a safe DMN 1.x document.
issue.EPC_NO_START_EVENT: The chain has no start event (an event without incoming flow).
issue.EPC_NO_END_EVENT: The chain has no end event (an event without outgoing flow).
issue.EPC_START_NOT_EVENT: The chain starts with a function or connector instead of an event.
issue.EPC_END_NOT_EVENT: The chain ends with a function or connector instead of an event.
issue.EPC_EVENT_EVENT: Two events follow each other: events and functions must alternate.
issue.EPC_FUNCTION_FUNCTION: Two functions follow each other: events and functions must alternate.
issue.EPC_DECISION_AFTER_EVENT: An XOR / OR split follows a single event: events cannot decide.
issue.EPC_CONNECTOR_DEGREE: A connector must split (one in, several out) or join (several in, one out).
issue.EPC_BRANCH_WITHOUT_CONNECTOR: Branches and joins need a connector.
issue.EPC_RESOURCE_UNASSIGNED: Organisational unit, system or document is not assigned to a function.
issue.SPACE_REQUIRED: Choose the space the pages go to.
issue.NO_DOCUMENTS_FOUND: No documents were found in the files.
issue.TEMPLATE_SECTIONS_ADDED: Template sections added to fill in: {{list}}
issue.PAGE_IN_OTHER_SPACE: The earlier imported page is in another space; it stays there.
issue.WORD_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: {{count}} parts of the document could not be converted exactly (check the page).
issue.PDF_NEEDS_MANUAL_WORK: Scanned PDF without text: needs manual work (the original is attached).
issue.BROKEN_LINKS: {{count}} links point to pages or files that are not in the export: {{list}}

ai.title: AI assistant for this batch
ai.help: Proposals only: every result goes to the review queue and is applied only when someone accepts it. Usage limits of the AI assistant apply.
ai.queueHelp: Review what the assistant proposed for imported items: accept creates drafts marked as AI output, reject discards the proposal.
ai.started: The assistant is working on {{count}} items; the proposals appear in the review queue.
ai.accepted: Accepted: created as a draft for review.
ai.notice: AI output can be wrong. It is created as a draft marked as AI output and must be checked before it is submitted for review.
ai.linkedProcess: Use the process linked to the page
